description: Runs ASR models exported to ONNX through the onnx-asr library, without a PyTorch dependency. This fighter runs the multilingual ARTPARK-IISc Vaani FastConformer checkpoint covering Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Odia, and Telugu.
notes: Model from the OpenVoiceOS 'stt-asr-onnx' HuggingFace collection.
